# Ayur Veda Global

> Ancient Ayurvedic Wisdom, Modern High-Performance Wellness. Ayur Veda Global is an authentic Ayurvedic D2C apothecary and formulation lab based in India, delivering standardized Rasayana supplements, herbal vitality therapies, and personalized BAMS Vaidya consultations nationwide.
